findings.title: Refresh a created study revision before each approval
findings.why_it_matters: After the owner creates a draft study from one application and approves it, approving another applicant into that same study fails with conflict until the intake page is reloaded. The locally appended created.study retains revision 0, the first memberSet increments the real study to revision 1, and the approval handler deliberately skips studyGet because the cached revision is an integer. Reading the current study immediately before every approval prevents this self-created stale revision while preserving genuine concurrent-edit conflicts.

findings.title: Bound the new intake access-store calls
findings.why_it_matters: A slow or unresponsive access-settings request can leave each public submission open before it reaches the SQL RPC, because the new route passes an access store whose Supabase fetch has no timeout. Concurrent submissions then retain server connections and callers receive no result, even though the research RPC itself has an eight-second limit. Give the intake access store a bounded timeout so these requests fail with the existing unavailable response and clients can retry using their request ID.

actionable_findings.title: Bound the new intake access-store calls
actionable_findings.why_it_matters: A slow or unresponsive access-settings request can leave each public submission open before it reaches the SQL RPC, because the new route passes an access store whose Supabase fetch has no timeout.
